title: HelperSSHConnectionResult
description: The identity of the one connection a destination's shell will ride (nocx-oalo1.5.3). It is DERIVED and not minted: the same endpoint, account, credential principal and route the pool and the supervisor key a connection by, rendered as a digest. Two coordinators asking about one destination therefore get one answer, and the answer survives a restart of either process. The coordinator uses it only as a correlation key; what a person reads is the state.

connectionId.description: A stable digest of the connection's identity, safe to publish: it names the account, the credential principal and the route without spelling any of them. Empty is not an answer, and a coordinator refuses it rather than binding a pane to nothing.
